children: Automakers on Sunday, November 1, are reporting their sales data for the month gone by.
Sales numbers have come in from Hyundai Motor India, Mahindra and Mahindra, Eicher Motors VECV, Escorts Kubota among others. Here's a look at more details:
The automaker reported total sales of 82,299 units in October, up 17.7% from the same period last year.
Its domestic sales increased 16.7% to 62,799 units and exports were up 21.1% at 19,500 units from the year-ago period.
The company reported total sales of 1,065 units in October. This was 1% more than the previous year's 1,059 units.
M&M's total sales in October increased 9% to 1.31 lakh units.
Its total passenger vehicles were up 2% at 73,338 units from last year's 71,624 units.
Its total exports were at 7,102 units, surging 77% from 4,015 units in October last year.
M&M reported a 12% decline in its tractor sales at 64,846 units compared to 73,660 units in the year-ago period.
The automaker's total sales in October increased 34.9% to 10,861 units from the previous year's 8,050 units.
The automaker's total sales were at 16,921 units in October. This was 10% lower than last year's 18,798 units.

title: From M&M to Eicher Motors — A look at how October auto sales have fared so far
